scope: Read-only post-run diagnosis of cases 02/03/07 parent stop timeout; original verdicts unchanged
interpretation: These are three stopped protocol-observation installations from source 9a7be2f8, driver 2b9707f6. Neither the later typed-stop/CAS patch nor the signal_calls receipt existed in these runs.

The original first request is already success/provider_terminal/stop and its S1 committed. This diagnostic does not change its three frozen primary checks, any strict protocol failure, or claim a completed child/full journey.

Driver source calls Popen.send_signal(SIGINT) immediately after saving first.observation.json, waits up to 30 seconds for the parent, then signals only its owned process group. The old receipt does not timestamp or acknowledge the initial SIGINT. File mtime is a surrounding evidence boundary, not an exact signal-send/receive time.

All three complete runtime logs contain zero 'shutdown signal' lines. This is an observation, not proof of OS signal non-delivery or the exact selected branch. Actual stop-vs-recovery intent was not persisted in these logs.

Each original native claim's chosen control admission failed local materialization with a subject_steps predecessor conflict. The Node rows contain a durable accepted control entry, while the Store materialization is absent. The later fork CAS explicitly cites that same chosen control:7 digest as unavailable selected-plan recovery.

Each log then records the old subject loop terminating and broker stopping, followed by reconstructing runtime, a new start/UI/subject, and a new branch/main request within the 30-second parent-stop window.

The final provider stream for the new request is open with zero units and no terminal. Its durable dispatched state indicates possible in-flight work; it does not prove provider execution continued or stopped. No live thread stacks or remote provider terminal status were captured.

Every observed timing scope in these three complete closed logs has a paired end, with no observed drops or invalid events. This excludes an unfinished observed native.claim as an explanation for the whole 30-second wait; it does not cover every possible runtime thread or physical provider wait.

Runtime scopes are nested. The displayed inclusive durations must not be added. Retained tail scopes and their self_us came from the full-log graph; window selection itself must not be used to recompute exclusives.

All three old requested children remain pending at revision 0, with zero retained operation/attempt/task-result rows, and the new subject root is a branch-fork root. These facts neither establish a native side effect nor allow silently retrying a chosen immutable plan.
All three final process-group cleanup receipts show SIGTERM, parent_exit -15, parent_timed_out true, no remaining live PID, parent reaped, and no SIGKILL. Strict protocol_passed remains false.
